purpose: Evidence and handoff for the final installed-source AV1 resource comparison and post-build visible return checks.

measurement.workload: 1080p30 AV1 + AAC stereo; 1280x720 visible canvas at 96 DPI; player defaults; HubThenOpen; 20.5s media alignment; 30s sampling; seven guarded snapshots per run. One warmup plus three measured processes per variant across three paired rounds.
limits: Memory categories overlap; three run-pair deltas are not confidence intervals.

The saved historical VLC 3.0.24 AV1 private-memory observation is 136.473 MiB; current Aperture is about 13.317 MiB higher. This is not a fresh matched VLC comparison and does not support an overall player win.

No CPU, frame cadence, dropped-frame, audio continuity, decoder/output equivalence, picture-quality, or statistical-significance claim. Sampling starts after 20.5s and does not measure the 15s retirement transition.

validation.buildAndRelease: 23/23 PR suites passed; release payload validated; source commit f868ad7 installed locally.
validation.unitSuite: 164 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped. The skipped case requires an explicit visible window; the fresh-process visible return suite is recorded separately.
validation.visibleReturn: Windowed, maximized, fullscreen, picture-in-picture, and minimized return modes passed their guarded checks.
validation.svgGeometry: Three factory ownership regressions passed after reproducing two failures with the shared-cache implementation. See before/after logs.
